title: Communications Committee report — Aug 17
summary: Victoria Bruce is stepping down as Communications Committee chair, so a new chair is needed. Lisa Bria is the new editor of The Link, and the committee is asking the Board to formally approve continued production of the weekly e-newsletter.
public_detail: Communication Committee Report — Meeting of August 17, 2026 * Victoria Bruce will be stepping down as Communication Committee Chair, as she and her husband are selling their residence in Palm Hill. A new chair will need to identified. * The committee welcomed Lisa Bria as the new editor of The Link. * Work continues on streamlining the process for uploading informational slides to the Community Channel on TV. The team will soon look into viewership data to help justify the ongoing effort. * Tony Ciaramitaro presented the new online amenity booking system, with plans to transition its administration to the Communication Committee. * Nearly all committee meeting minutes for 2025 and 2026 have been uploaded to the Palm Hill website, under the "HOPH Information" section. * A sub-committee has been formed to begin work on Candidates Night. * The team continues to produce the weekly e-newsletter and is working to streamline distribution procedures. With four issues now distributed, the committee is requesting from the Board formal approval to continue production.
